data:
erDiagram
    users {
        UUID id PK
        VARCHAR(255) username "NOT NULL, UNIQUE"
        TEXT password "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) role "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
    }

    parent_profiles {
        UUID user_id PK, FK
        VARCHAR(255) full_name "NOT NULL"
        TEXT shipping_address "NULL"
    }

    child_profiles {
        UUID user_id PK, FK
        UUID parent_id FK
        VARCHAR(255) display_name "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(255) real_name "NULL"
        SMALLINT birth_year "NULL"
        TEXT avatar_url "NULL"
        INTEGER time_limit_minutes "NULL"
        BOOLEAN teacher_can_view_info "NOT NULL, DEFAULT FALSE"
    }

    teacher_profiles {
        UUID user_id PK, FK
        VARCHAR(255) full_name "NOT NULL"
        TEXT certificates_text "NOT NULL"
        TEXT bank_account_info "NOT NULL"
    }

    courses {
        UUID id PK
        UUID teacher_id FK
        UUID customize_request_id FK "NULL"
        VARCHAR(255) name "NOT NULL"
        TEXT description "NULL"
        VARCHAR(100) category "NULL"
        TEXT cover_image_url "NULL"
        NUMERIC price "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
    }

    lessons {
        UUID id PK
        UUID course_id FK
        VARCHAR(255) title "NOT NULL"
        TEXT video_url "NULL"
        BOOLEAN is_trial "NOT NULL"
        BOOLEAN has_assignment "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
    }

    supplies {
        UUID id PK
        UUID teacher_id FK
        VARCHAR(255) name "NOT NULL"
        TEXT description "NULL"
        TEXT image_url "NULL"
        NUMERIC price "NOT NULL"
        INTEGER stock_quantity "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
    }

    course_supplies {
        UUID course_id PK, FK
        UUID supply_id PK, FK
    }

    orders {
        UUID id PK
        UUID parent_id FK
        NUMERIC total_amount "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
        TIMESTAMPTZ expired_at "NULL"
    }

    sub_orders {
        UUID id PK
        UUID order_id FK
        UUID teacher_id FK
        NUMERIC sub_total "NOT NULL"
        NUMERIC shipping_fee "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(100) shipping_provider "NULL"
        VARCHAR(100) tracking_code "NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
    }

    sub_order_supplies {
        UUID id PK
        UUID sub_order_id FK
        UUID supply_id FK
        INTEGER quantity "NOT NULL"
        NUMERIC price "NOT NULL"
    }

    order_courses {
        UUID id PK
        UUID order_id FK
        UUID course_id FK
        UUID child_id FK
        NUMERIC price "NOT NULL"
    }

    child_courses {
        UUID child_id PK, FK
        UUID course_id PK, FK
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
    }

    lesson_progress {
        UUID child_id PK, FK
        UUID lesson_id PK, FK
        INTEGER watched_seconds "NOT NULL"
        BOOLEAN is_completed "NOT NULL"
    }

    submissions {
        UUID id PK
        UUID child_id FK
        UUID lesson_id FK
        TEXT image_url "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
        TEXT teacher_feedback "NULL"
        VARCHAR(100) badge "NULL"
    }

    customize_requests {
        UUID id PK
        UUID parent_id FK
        VARCHAR(255) title "NOT NULL"
        TEXT description "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(100) category "NULL"
        SMALLINT child_age "NOT NULL"
        NUMERIC budget "NOT NULL"
        TIMESTAMPTZ deadline "NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
    }

    offers {
        UUID id PK
        UUID request_id FK
        UUID teacher_id FK
        NUMERIC price "NOT NULL"
        TEXT message "NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
    }

    conversations {
        UUID id PK
        UUID parent_id FK
        UUID teacher_id FK
        VARCHAR(50) context_type "NOT NULL"
        UUID context_id "NOT NULL"
    }

    messages {
        UUID id PK
        UUID conversation_id FK
        UUID sender_id FK
        TEXT content "NOT NULL"
        BOOLEAN is_offer "NOT NULL"
        TIMESTAMPTZ created_at "NOT NULL"
    }

    held_funds {
        UUID id PK
        UUID teacher_id FK
        VARCHAR(50) source_type "NOT NULL"
        UUID source_id "NOT NULL"
        NUMERIC amount "NOT NULL"
        NUMERIC commission_amount "NOT NULL"
        NUMERIC net_amount "NOT NULL"
        UUID payout_batch_id FK "NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
    }

    payout_batches {
        UUID id PK
        UUID teacher_id FK
        NUMERIC total_amount "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(100) transaction_code "NULL"
        TEXT proof_image_url "NULL"
    }

    refunds {
        UUID id PK
        UUID parent_id FK
        VARCHAR(50) source_type "NOT NULL"
        UUID source_id "NOT NULL"
        NUMERIC amount "NOT NULL"
        VARCHAR(20) status "NOT NULL"
    }

    course_reviews {
        UUID id PK
        UUID course_id FK
        UUID parent_id FK
        SMALLINT rating "NOT NULL"
        TEXT comment "NULL"
    }

    system_configs {
        VARCHAR(100) key PK
        TEXT value "NOT NULL"
    }

    %% QUAN HỆ TÀI KHOẢN VÀ HỒ SƠ (USERS & PROFILES)
    users ||--|| parent_profiles : "has"
    users ||--|| child_profiles : "has"
    users ||--|| teacher_profiles : "has"
    users ||--o{ child_profiles : "parent manages"

    %% QUAN HỆ KHÓA HỌC VÀ DỤNG CỤ (COURSES & SUPPLIES)
    users ||--o{ courses : "teacher creates"
    users ||--o{ supplies : "teacher creates"
    courses ||--o{ lessons : "contains"
    courses ||--o{ course_supplies : "recommends"
    supplies ||--o{ course_supplies : "recommended in"
    courses ||--o{ course_reviews : "receives"
    users ||--o{ course_reviews : "parent writes"

    %% QUAN HỆ ĐƠN HÀNG VÀ THANH TOÁN (ORDERS & PAYMENTS)
    users ||--o{ orders : "parent places"
    orders ||--o{ sub_orders : "split into"
    users ||--o{ sub_orders : "teacher fulfills"
    orders ||--o{ order_courses : "includes"
    courses ||--o{ order_courses : "sold in"
    users ||--o{ order_courses : "assigned to child"
    sub_orders ||--o{ sub_order_supplies : "includes"
    supplies ||--o{ sub_order_supplies : "sold in"

    %% QUAN HỆ HỌC TẬP (LEARNING & PROGRESS)
    users ||--o{ child_courses : "child enrolled in"
    courses ||--o{ child_courses : "has enrolled"
    users ||--o{ lesson_progress : "child tracks"
    lessons ||--o{ lesson_progress : "tracked by"
    users ||--o{ submissions : "child submits"
    lessons ||--o{ submissions : "receives"

    %% QUAN HỆ YÊU CẦU CUSTOMIZE (CUSTOMIZE REQUESTS)
    users ||--o{ customize_requests : "parent requests"
    customize_requests ||--o{ offers : "receives"
    users ||--o{ offers : "teacher makes"
    customize_requests ||--o| courses : "results in"

    %% QUAN HỆ TIN NHẮN (MESSAGES)
    users ||--o{ conversations : "parent participates"
    users ||--o{ conversations : "teacher participates"
    conversations ||--o{ messages : "contains"
    users ||--o{ messages : "sends"

    %% QUAN HỆ TÀI CHÍNH (FUNDS & PAYOUTS)
    users ||--o{ held_funds : "teacher earns"
    payout_batches ||--o{ held_funds : "pays out"
    users ||--o{ payout_batches : "teacher receives"
    users ||--o{ refunds : "parent receives"
